items.title_orig: Green River (a band from Seattle) turned into Mudhoney, Pearl Jam, Temple of the Dog, Mother Love Bone and Love Battery.
items.article_text:
Not having Marcus acknowledge the existence of a band that all grew up together there and named their band after a local active serial killer that turned into several subsequent bands sortable from respectable to epic is driving me bonkers.
 Their 1988 “Rehab Doll” was the 15th record released by Sub Pop.
 The 1990 reissue of that with their new EP “Dry as a Bone” is the one to look for on streaming platforms.
 Groovy stuff, worth tracking down. Make a solid No Dogs episode.
 For fans of the label it’s foundational. Enjoy, friends
